newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Two firms upgrade N.Y.Times.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Two firms upgrade N.Y.Times.

text.p: -- Two brokerage firms upgraded New York Times Co.
-- Lehman Brothers confirmed that it raised its rating to buy from outperform and added the stock to its U.S. recommended list.
-- Salomon Brothers also upgraded New York Times to buy from hold, according to a market source.
-- Lehamn raised its 1997 earnings estimate to $2.25 a share from $1.95 and set a 1998 estimate of $2.60.
-- Lehman said it raised the 12-month price target to $50 a share from $40.
-- Lehman said the New York Times board may announce a "significant" share buyback plan at its February 20 meeting.
-- Lehman also said there will be other catalysts in the company's future, including an analysts' meeting in June and the rollout of the full-color edition of The New York Times in September.
-- Details on Salomon's upgrade were not available.
